sentences.text: This petition is filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. seeking to enlarge the petitioner on bail in Crime No.120/2023 of Chikkanayakanahalli Police Station, Tumakuru registered for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. The law was set into motion by the victim's mother, on the basis of which the aforementioned crime was registered against the petitioner.
It is alleged that the petitioner has committed penetrative sexual assault on the minor daughter of the complainant, due to which she conceived and delivered a baby on 15.08.2023.
The learned counsel for the petitioner has contended that the petitioner is innocent and he is falsely implicated in the case.

He has contended that in the complaint name of one Sharath is also mentioned and it is clearly stated that on an earlier occasion a complaint was lodged against the said Sharath and for extraneous reasons, the petitioner has been arraigned as an accused.
He has relied upon the statement of the victim and her mother submitted before the Sessions Court, wherein they have exonerated the petitioner.
4. The learned High Court Government Pleader has contended that DNA report is yet to be received and therefore, at this stage, this is not a fit case to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

5. At para 14 of the order passed by the learned Sessions Judge, it is observed that blood sample of the victim, her baby and the accused is yet to be drawn for NC: 2024:KHC:2142 the purposes of DNA profiling and investigation is yet to be completed.
Hence, it is too premature to observe anything on the contention raised by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

It is submitted that now the investigation is completed and charge sheet is filed.
In that view of the matter, the petitioner is permitted to file a fresh petition before the Sessions Court.

In that event,
the learned Sessions Judge shall consider the said petition in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible.
With the above observation, the petition is disposed of.
